text: Drinks are poured in several neighborhoods, not one spot. The Windmill has a coffee vendor, a Pickathon sponsor every year, and its own bar. The Market, the boardwalk for food, drink and craft, has kombucha from Brew Doctor. The Grove opened in 2022 with a craft beer garden under tall trees, and the Courtyard by the Galaxy Barn has a bar and meet-up space.
sources: Zale rulings Nov 24 via festival_history-49 (Windmill coffee and bar, kombucha at Market); map guide Jul 20 2023 (Market); pickathon.com/2022/08/dance-dine-in-the-grove-market-neighborhoods; pickathon.com/?p=37447 Courtyard sneak peek Jun 17 2024

text: The Windmill has a coffee vendor, a Pickathon sponsor every year, and its own bar, so the hillside covers both ends of the day. DJs spin here from morning into the small hours, so a drink comes with a record on. Food vendors turn up some years too.
sources: Zale ruling Nov 24 11:35 (festival_history-49); catalog_Schedule_2024 (Windmill DJs 10 AM to late)

text: The Grove opened in 2022 as an all-new neighborhood in a stand of tall trees beside the Market, with a craft beer garden and nearly twenty vinyl DJs after dark. By 2025 its bar posted the beer list on a board.
sources: pickathon.com/2022/08/dance-dine-in-the-grove-market-neighborhoods (Aug 3 2022); photo_changes_log Nov 22 (2025 Grove bar with beer-list board)

text: The Courtyard sits just outside the Galaxy Barn. In 2024 its open-air passage and pavilion held a bar and meet-up space, with a fire pit, morning yoga and late-night vinyl DJ sets. The barn's late sets are steps away.
sources: pickathon.com/?p=37447 Courtyard sneak peek (Jun 17 2024); neighborhoods_by_year 2024 galaxy-courtyard row

text: Kombucha from Brew Doctor now has its home at the Market, a boardwalk beside Cherry Hill for food and drink, craft vendors and a farmers market. It used to be poured at the Windmill, and it has since moved here.
sources: Zale ruling Nov 24 11:35 (festival_history-49); map guide Jul 20 2023

text: Food vendors gather at the Market, a boardwalk beside Cherry Hill with food and drink, craft vendors and a farmers market. The 2026 list included Pine State Biscuits, Ate Oh Ate for Hawaiian food, Poblano for Mexican, Smoke & Brine for smoked meats, Fitts Seafood and Obon Shokudo. For a sit-down meal there is Curation, with ticketed dinners cooked by a chef alongside Pickathon artists.
sources: nonmusic_lineup_wp_nov7.csv (Food 2026); genre_tags_nonmusic.csv (styles); map guide Jul 20 2023; pickathon.com/2023/06/curation-2023-announced

text: The Market's vendor row mixes Portland names and carts: Pine State Biscuits for breakfast sandwiches, Poblano's Mexican food, Carioca Bowls, Bombay Station, Donut Drop and Cobra Dogs in 2026. Ice cream, smoked meats and seafood were on the list too. Vendors change from year to year.
sources: nonmusic_lineup_wp_nov7.csv (Food 2024 to 2026); genre_tags_nonmusic.csv

text: Curation is the sit-down meal: ticketed dinners where a chef cooks and Pickathon artists play, in a hidden corner of the farm beside a creek. The 2026 gatherings began with a Friday dinner on July 31, five in all, with Cathy Whims of Nostrana among the chefs.
sources: 2026 Curation post (festival_history-48); nonmusic_lineup_wp_nov7.csv (Curation 2026); pickathon.com/2023/06/curation-2023-announced

text: Craft is makers selling what they made, at the Market and at the Paddock. The 2026 list included Hat People, an Oregon family of hat makers, Fluff Hardware with hand-forged jewelry, Spoke & Word Books, a queer-owned bookstore from Milwaukie, and Skin Fancy with botanical skincare from the Columbia Gorge.
sources: 2026 craft post; genre_tags_nonmusic.csv (Craft rows); photo_changes_log Nov 22 (booths in both Market and Paddock, low confidence)

text: Merry Pop In Shop sells secondhand and repurposed goods at the Paddock. It was on the craft list in 2025 and again in 2026, near the neighborhood's wood-pole stage.
sources: 2025 and 2026 craft posts; genre_tags_nonmusic.csv; experience_photo_coverage_nov21.md (Paddock)

text: Wellness is spread over a few places. The Refuge has showers, massage, sound baths and tea. Yoga happens in the Lucky Barn and at the Galaxy Courtyard, runs leave from the Windmill Stage, and guided hikes toward Scouters Mountain set out from the Windmill neighborhood.
sources: festival_history-49 and -48 (Yoga, Qi Gong and runs are not in the Refuge); catalog_Schedule_2024; wellness posts Jul 22 2023 and Jun 25 2024

text: The Refuge is Pickathon's wellness neighborhood under the trees. Cedar showers and a private 45-minute massage were offered in 2025 and 2026. Earlier years added a sauna space and cold plunge (2024), sound baths, tea meditation, and a lending library with reading nooks (2023). Programs change every year, so the schedule has this year's list.
sources: refuge_programs_by_year_nov24_draft1.csv (festival_history-49); wellness posts Jun 25 2024, Jun 20 2025, Jul 24 2025, Jul 25 2026, Jul 22 2023

text: Friday morning at the Windmill, local hikers lead a climb toward Scouters Mountain Nature Park. In 2024 it left at 8 AM with Brett Sherman and the Happy Valley Hikers, and the 2025 post called it a gentle climb. Fun runs start from the Windmill Stage too.
sources: wellness posts Jul 22 2023 and Jun 25 2024; 2025 wellness post; catalog_Schedule_2024 (Fun Run, Windmill)

text: Yoga starts the day in the Lucky Barn, the smaller air-conditioned barn. In 2024 the first class, a Deep Stretch with Karli Janine Erickson, began at 7:30 AM Friday. The same barn hosts stand-up comedy at night.
sources: catalog_Schedule_2024; map guide Jul 20 2023 (Lucky Barn)

text: Morning yoga at the Courtyard, just outside the Galaxy Barn. In 2024 Flow Yoga with Danny Meza started at 8 AM Friday, and Power Flow followed at 9:30. The same pavilion hosts late-night vinyl DJ sets.
sources: catalog_Schedule_2024; pickathon.com/?p=37447 Courtyard sneak peek (Jun 17 2024)

text: Coyote is a kids-first neighborhood in the woods above Cherry Hill. Its programs have included Music Together classes, a My Voice Music talent show and ukulele lessons, Trackers Earth wilderness adventures with foam archery, crafts and role-playing, a Sunday Puppet Parade with Making Earth Cool, Cedarwood childcare and a Family Feeding Nest. The 2026 build was Captain Coyote's Frog Bog.
sources: festival_history-48 (2024 to 2026 Coyote posts); neighborhoods_by_year 2023 and 2024 Coyote rows; catalog_Schedule_2024

text: Comedy plays in the Lucky Barn, the smaller air-conditioned barn. Pickathon Laughs brought stand-up in 2024, hosted by Amy Miller at 7:30 PM Friday, and the 2025 and 2026 comedy posts list 90-minute shows. Every comedy booking on record is stand-up.
sources: catalog_Schedule_2024; festival_history-48 (2025 and 2026 comedy posts); genre_tags_nonmusic.csv

text: Sunday morning on the Woods Stage is for words. LIT Sunday 2025 opened with Imagine Storytelling at 11 AM, and spoken word and author readings were part of the program. Frayn Masters of Back Fence PDX read here in 2023. Literary bookings begin in 2022.
sources: genre_tags_nonmusic.csv (LIT Sunday 2025 bios; Frayn Masters 2023); nonmusic_lineup_wp_nov7.csv

text: Authors read at the Windmill on Sunday morning. The 2025 LIT Sunday author lineup spanned memoirists, poets, novelists and screenwriters, and past readers include Omar El Akkad in 2022, Willy Vlautin in 2024 and Leah Sottile in 2026.
sources: genre_tags_nonmusic.csv (Authors rows); Zale ruling via photo_changes_log Nov 22 (literary at Woods and Windmill)

text: After the headliners, the dancing moves into the neighborhoods. In 2024 DJs played the Woods, Grove, Windmill and Galaxy Barn from morning into the small hours. The Grove opened in 2022 with nearly twenty vinyl DJs, the Orchard's Wormhole ran late-night vinyl dance parties in 2023, and Cherry Hill added a bar and DJ area on its hill in 2022.
sources: catalog_Schedule_2024; Grove post Aug 3 2022; Orchard post Jul 6 2023; Cherry Hill post Jul 30 2022
